entry.title: Status Of Anthropic IPO As AI Fears Mount
entry.summary: Bloomberg's Anthony Hughes joins Scarlet Fu on "Bloomberg Deals." Anthropic is preparing for its IPO and has picked Nasdaq as its listing venue. entry.title: What Blockchain Still Needs to Win Wall Street
entry.summary: Kaiko CEO Ambre Soubiran joins Bloomberg Open Interest to explain why blockchain adoption on Wall Street is taking longer than expected. She argues the technology is ready, but tokenized markets still need trusted data, risk controls and traditional market safeguards before 24/7 trading and instant settlement can scale. (Source: Bloomberg)
